lee_sales: FYI we kicked off a request from Biogen for a 10-day POC. They want Dedicated pool + SSO, strict RBAC, and proof of audit retention. Can we scope minimal access?

anika_se: yes. plan: create `poc_observer` (metrics/logs), `poc_runner` (inference only), and `poc_admin` limited to pool config. Ephemeral invites TTL 10 days.

rachel_security: add: KMS-backed encryption for any persisted tokens, detailed audit log export, and explicit PHI prohibition. We need an AIA signed before granting inference access.

priya_platform: we can spin up pool `ded-bio-01` today. CLI invites example: 
```
redwood workspace invite --email bob@biogen.com --role poc_runner --expires 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z --restrict-pool ded-bio-01
```
We support `--session-ttl` for hosted smoke keys as well. Hosted keys allowed only for initial smoke (1h TTL) and must have `--no-data-retain` flag.

lee_sales: they'll likely want hosted keys first (smoke) then Dedicated. Good to know about `--no-data-retain`. I'll capture AIA signatures before we enable inference.

anika_se: also: bind API tokens to `pool_id` so they fail if used elsewhere. We'll restrict allowed models to `rwd-q*` family and disable file uploads.

rachel_security: provide a revoke runbook. If a credential is compromised we need immediate revoke + KMS rotate. Also provide a screenshot of KMS policy and logs retention policy to the customer.

priya_platform: revoke flow: 
1) `POST /admin/tokens/revoke` with token id or `--role poc_*` filter; 
2) `POST /admin/pool/rotate-keys?pool=ded-bio-01` to rotate pool keys; 
3) run `redwood audit export --since 24h --filter "email:biogen.com"` and share to security.
I'll add these commands to a one-click script and push to the internal gist.

devops-bot: :white_check_mark: gist created at https://internal.gists/redwood/biogen-poc-playbook (priya_platform)

lee_sales: timeline: I will collect signed AIA by EOD tomorrow. If delayed, we only grant hosted smoke keys (1h) and no inference.

anika_se: create guest cleanup job to remove `poc_*` accounts after 14 days and nightly token scan to flag long-lived keys. Quick cron snippet: 
```
# daily at 02:00
0 2 * * * redwood tokens list --filter "role:poc_* AND age>7d" | xargs -r redwood tokens revoke
```

rachel_security: perfect. also document escalation contact (rachel_security + priya_platform) for customer ops. Add legal on AIA cc.

priya_platform: I'll DM lee_sales the pool id and admin invite once provisioned. Planning to restrict egress from the pool for extra safety (no external callbacks).

lee_sales: appreciate it. I'll update Biogen and confirm PHI stance and AIA signature flow. :thumbsup:
